name: Victorious Fantasy Sports
author: victoriousclub

sections.description:
Victorious Fantasy Sports lets you build and manage fantasy contests on your WordPress site without writing a line of code. Set up private or public leagues for traditional sports (football, baseball, hockey, basketball, soccer) or alternative markets (stock tickers, crypto tokens). Choose from multiple game styles—drafts, pick’em, parlays, props, and more—and customize entry fees and scoring rules.

Key features include:
* Game Modes – Drafts, pick’em, parlay, prop bets, season‑long and daily formats.
* Live Scoring – Real‑time updates with live leaderboards and scoring pages.
* Custom Scoring – Flexible scoring rules per sport or market.
* Deposits & Withdrawals – Integrated payments (PayPal) with balance management.
* Cryptocurrency Support – Accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP and more.
* User‑Created Contests – Allow your community to run their own games.
* Serviceware Integration – Data feeds, schedules, results and fantasy engine logic are hosted on Victorious servers for accuracy and speed.

The plugin is free to download, but you’ll need a valid license key from victorious.club to enable live data feeds and the game engine. Victorious adheres to WordPress.org plugin guidelines and maintains secure connections to our API services.

License & Terms

Victorious Fantasy Sports is released under the GPLv2 license. It is serviceware: the core plugin is open source, but it relies on our hosted services for game schedules, results, data feeds and business logic. By using a license key you agree to our terms of service. Each site requires its own license. We adhere to the WordPress.org guidelines and ensure all data is securely managed.
sections.installation:
To get started, choose one of these methods:

  1. Install via Dashboard

    • In WordPress, go to Plugins → Add New.
    • Search for “Victorious Fantasy Sports”.
    • Click Install Now, then Activate.
    • Navigate to the Victorious settings page and enter your license key from your Victorious.club account.

  2. Upload the ZIP

    • Download the latest ZIP from victorious.club.
    • In WordPress, go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
    • Choose the downloaded ZIP and click Install Now.
    • Activate the plugin and enter your license key in the admin panel.

  3. Install via FTP

    • Extract the ZIP and upload the victorious folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
    • Activate the plugin in the WordPress admin.
    • Enter your license key in the Victorious settings page.
sections.faq:
Do I need a license?

Yes. Although the plugin is free to download, a valid license key unlocks the live data feeds and scoring engine. Sign up at victorious.club to obtain a key.

What sports and markets are supported?

We cover NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, soccer, esports, and alternative markets like stocks and cryptocurrency. Contact us if you need a different feed.

How do payouts work?

Configure your PayPal email in the admin panel. User deposits go directly to your account, and you can process withdrawal requests via the plugin. We support multiple payment gateways and can integrate custom options on request.

Do you offer support?

Yes. We provide 24/7 email support for all license tiers. Reach us at support@victorious.club with any questions or feedback.

Can I join your team?

We’re always looking for talent. If you’d like to contribute, email support@victorious.club.
